errors.evidence: The description lists 'Латвия' (Latvia) as one of the countries on the x-axis, but the chart actually shows 'Литва' (Lithuania).
The description states that the y-axis has intervals of 5, but the labeled tick marks on the chart are at intervals of 10 (0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50).
In the sentence about Czechia, the description states that women work 41.84 hours, but the chart shows the value is 43.54 hours. The value 41.84 corresponds to the average hours for men in Estonia.
